name: paseo-buddy
description: Floating desktop companion for Paseo agents

scripts.test: npm run runtime:build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @paseo-buddy/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build --workspace @paseo-buddy/desktop
scripts.desktop:stage: npm run desktop:build && node scripts/stage-desktop.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-stage.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:stage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
